sentences.translation: # I'm going to go to the fiddle.
sora was just under the entrance.
i wonder if it's okay to go.
but i didn't get a swoop from my mouth.
i've been scratched at the entrance.
it was like a big thing.
i'll go in. i know what i mean.
But when I entered, I was instructed.
i thought it was a big deal.
the river's first half was in the entrance.
and then slowly began to exist.
